confidence_notes: Medium overall: holistic estimates from general knowledge of Amman price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and hostel anchors are more reliable; the 3-star hotel and alcohol anchors are less certain (seasonal and regional demand, tax-driven alcohol pricing). Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the beer anchor because direct price knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from an RBA-domain web search summary that cites the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used. Regional basis is Levant and Middle East capital price levels, with Amman's restaurant and hotel prices judged to sit above Cairo and below Beirut.
